portfolio.title: ClutterCtrl
portfolio.description: A fast, zero-dependency terminal file organizer built in pure Python. Sorts cluttered folders by file type, previews every change with dry runs, watches folders in the background, and keeps per-run logs for 1-click undo.

portfolio.title: JSON Analyst
portfolio.description: A 100% client-side JSON toolkit that validates, formats, repairs, compacts, and converts JSON to CSV, plus interactive chart and tree views for exploring structure. Built with zero runtime dependencies and a TypeScript analysis library, with nothing ever sent to a server.
